ana: heads up — spotted a typing regression in the autogen pydantic models for the python SDK. when a field is Union[List[str], List[int]] the generator emits List[Any] and the generated __init__ drops the arg type, so mypy chokes in the sampleapp repro.

sam: can you paste a tiny repro?

ana: sure, here's the diff (generated vs expected):
```py
# generated (bad)
class MixedModel(BaseModel):
    items: List[Any]

# expected
class MixedModel(BaseModel):
    items: Union[List[str], List[int]]

# call site fails mypy: my_model.items -> Any, loses element types
```

julia: ugh. that smells like the generator collapsing unions with identical origins. probably the portion that resolves typing.get_origin / typing.get_args is returning a flattened type and we stringify as Any. also we don't emit "from __future__ import annotations" in the sample-generated modules which makes runtime vs static types diverge.

kevin: workaround for now: use typing.cast at call sites or annotate the sampleapp model manually: `items: Union[List[str], List[int]]` — ugly but unblocks onboarding.

devx-bot: issue created: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/4242 — includes sampleapp repro, mypy output, and the failing generated file :eyes:

ana: i'm drafting a generator fix: preserve original generic expressions for Union-of-same-origin, add a test that runs mypy against the sampleapp, and ensure the module header includes future annotations. will open draft PR in a few hours.

sam: can we also gate this with a mypy/pyright smoke in CI so we catch regressions? pyright reported a slightly different complaint in our internal lsp tests.

julia: yep, i'll add a CI job that runs mypy and pyright on the autogen output in SDK repo. also adding a small integration test that imports the generated module and asserts typing.get_origin/get_args behavior — cheap and effective.

kevin: bumping priority — this breaks a customer onboarding flow where they rely on element types for validation. can we flag for a patch release if PR lands? :pray:

ana: noted. i'll tag the PR with `hotfix` and link the issue. leaving the repro in `examples/onboarding/sampleapp` so QA can validate.

sam: thanks — please @mention me on the PR so I can help with the CI config.

julia: adding a note to SDK docs about the generator's current limitations until the fix lands, so folks know the temporary cast workaround.

ana: thanks all. keeping thread here for updates, will post PR link when ready.
